title: Additivity of Gaussian noise
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $f,g:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ be integrable under the product standard Gaussian measure. The Gaussian noise operator at parameter $\rho$ sends $f+g$ to the pointwise sum of its values on $f$ and $g$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is integrable under the product standard Gaussian measure
$g$ is integrable under the product standard Gaussian measure
